main_text.p: τοιοῦτός τις οἷ[?] ἐ-γείρειν ἀξίᾳ[?] καθόλ-δον[?]ζα εἰσελθὼν, ἵνα αὐτῷ λαλῇ. ἀνά-γκαθαι[?] δὲ μέλλοντας κωλύειν. προσελ-θὼν, δὲς[?] ὅπως ἐᾶν, ἕως ἂν ἐπιπατήσῃ[?].

τὸ παιδίον τῆς πίτης ἀφελόμ[?]ενον μασσώμυνον[?], σπίζειν αὐτὸς, ὑποκορίζε-σθαι ὡς ποπαύζων[?]. καὶ ἐδίων δ᾽ ἅμα δι-ηγεῖας ὡς ἐλέξογν[?] πιῶν, ἄνω καὶ κάτω καθαρθεῖν. ὁ ζωμὸν[?] τὰ [illegible, ~12 letters] ἐν τοῖς ὑποχωρήμασιν αὐτῷ μελαντέρα ἡ χολή. ἐρωτῆσαι δὲ δεινὸς ἐναντίον τῶν οἰκείων, ὡς ποία ἡ-μέρα μεταπίπτει καὶ ὅτι ψυχρὸν ὕδωρ δῶ παρ᾽ αὐτῷ λακκαῖον.

ὡς κἂπ[?]ῳ λάχα-qui vix incipientem dor-mire,excitet, ingressus vt cum eo colloquatur : & qui ad eum accedens qui inibi eft,vt nauim foluat, moram ei afferat, & expectare iubeat,donec aliquot secum spatia confecerit. Infantem etiá puerum nutrici suæ admens, ipse mansum ei cibum in os inferet, & blandiculè compellans , poppysmis permulcebit. Inter edendum narrat se helleboro accepto , quæ in vifceribus hærerent, eiecisse deiecisseque : tum addit, in effusis bilem fuisse iure appolito magis atram. A matre præsentibus amicis & familiaribus. quærere amat,Ecqua me die, mater,peperisti ? Aquam ait sibi esse in cisterna frigidam : olera in horto multa

page.notes: The Greek is small and partly faint, so several words are doubtful and are marked [?]. The small sign glyphs at the starts of some lines are not transcribed. Line 8 and the line on the right edge are doubtful. The line ending "λάχα-" continues on the next part of the page, and the page ends there. The first word of the running head is hard to read letter by letter; the spacing suggests "HRASTI" but it may be a longer word. The letters "s" and "f" are read as long s where the context requires it. Some spelling, such as "fri-gidam", "de-iecisseque" and "infantem", is kept as printed.
